description: Probe of the GUI BEFORE the fix (bundle index-CLqLDtTO.js, API 1.1.0) on the cloud replica, 2026-11-23 12:15 -05:00, Playwright Chromium: how many POST /varieties each action sends and how many rows are created. Script: dblclick_probe.cjs (copy in this folder).
interpretation: A normal double click or a double Enter sent one request (React disabled the button before the second event). Two activations processed before React re-rendered (same task) sent two requests, and the API stored both rows (706/707 and 708/709 are identical): the form had no synchronous lock and the API had no uniqueness check.
